meta.notes: Native only (genai-native's perception engine, a clean-room engine for CorridorKey's design): a green- or blue-screen picture and a rough hint of the subject (the mask: 0 background, 255 subject) give an RGBA image of the subject's straight (un-mixed) colour and its alpha, at the picture's size. The model works at 2048 x 2048 whatever the picture's shape. Parameter refinerStrength (default 1) scales the full-resolution refiner's corrections. Weights: CorridorKey_v1.0.safetensors from the authors' Hugging Face page (nikopueringer/CorridorKey_v1.0), in models/corridorkey/.
meta.creator: Corridor Digital
meta.description: Keys a green or blue screen: clean alpha and spill-free subject colour from a rough hint
